app.name: Masteva
app.tagline: Learn in one place, from understanding concepts to doing it in real projects.
app.intro: Complete roadmaps, visual lessons, labs on your own machine and end-to-end projects, for developers.
app.footer: Content licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Sample code licensed under MIT.

roadmaps.title: Roadmaps
roadmaps.subtitle: Each roadmap goes from foundations to senior, split into ordered steps. You can follow several roadmaps at once.

roadmap.finished: You have finished every core topic of this roadmap.
roadmap.howToReadBody: Read from top to bottom. Each station is a step, each chip is a topic. Select a topic to see details and track your progress. Progress is stored in this browser only.
roadmap.levelKnown: You marked this level as already known.
roadmap.lessonSoonWithResources: The lesson for this topic is being written. The official docs below are enough to start; when you are done, mark it Done so the map updates.
roadmap.lessonSoonBare: The lesson and docs for this topic are being written. If you already know it, mark it Done or Skip and move on to the next topic.
roadmap.loadFailed: Could not load the topic. Check your connection and reload the page.
roadmap.movedTitle: This roadmap has been split into three
roadmap.movedBody: Java, DevOps and Microservices are now separate roadmaps, each going from foundations to senior. Your progress is kept.

home.pickRoadmap: Pick a roadmap below to start.
home.partsTitle: Every lesson has 6 parts, in this order

parts.title: Goal
parts.body: What you will understand and be able to do, and which production situations you can explain.

parts.title: Knowledge
parts.body: Explained from the ground up: what, why, how it works underneath, where it goes wrong.

parts.title: Resources
parts.body: A few official sources for further reading, with notes on what to read. Optional.

parts.title: Practice
parts.body: Labs on your own machine, with where to run each command and the expected output.

parts.title: Deep dive
parts.body: Open questions with hidden answers, and how to work on this with AI correctly.

parts.title: Mastery
parts.body: Things you can do on your own. Tick each one to track your progress.

home.progressNote: Progress is stored in this browser, no account needed. To continue on another machine, export your progress on a roadmap page and import it there.

lesson.untranslated: This lesson has not been translated into your language yet. Showing the Vietnamese version.
lesson.staleTranslation: This translation may be outdated compared to the Vietnamese original.
lesson.predictGuess: Write down your guess before you look

progress.notPersistent: Your browser is blocking storage; progress will be lost when you close the page.
progress.title: Your progress
progress.desc: Progress is stored only in this browser. Export it to a file to keep it or move it to another device; importing merges with your current progress instead of overwriting it.
